evidence.name: Screen field: Color the footer background
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Color the footer background" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Color the footer background
sections.description: Sets the fill color of the whole footer block, which holds the purchase button, the auto-renew note, and the legal links (default a dark tone). Pick a color that makes your button pop and keeps the renewal note and legal links readable. If you switch to a light footer, darken those text colors so everything stays legible.
